entities.summary: Larry Stewart was an American philanthropist from Kansas City better known as "Kansas City's Secret Santa". After poor beginnings, Stewart – from 1979 through 2006 – made a practice of anonymously handing out small amounts of cash, typically in the form of hundred-dollar bills, to needy people.
